question:
Choose the word that means the same as the given word.

Ulterior
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 4' **i.e. **'Eventual'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word that means the same as **"Ulterior"** is: **'Eventual'**
 
• In English, **"Ulterior" **refers to something that is existing beyond what is obvious or admitted; intentionally hidden.
 
• **"Eventual"** is the closest synonym among the given options, it means happening or existing at a later time.

Therefore, the **correct answer** is: *'Eventual'.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Let's go through the other options:
 
 
• **"Anterior"** means situated before or at the front of;(पूर्व)
 
• **"Prior" **means earlier in time; before.(पूर्व)
 
• **"Ancient" **means belonging to the very distant past and no longer in existence.(प्राचीन)
